Delhivery: Milestone year as full-year PAT delivered
Gurugram, Haryana, May 16, 2025: Delhivery Limited (NSE: DELHIVERY, BOM: 543529)
announced Q4 FY25 and full year FY25 results today.
Q4 FY25 results snapshot:
● Revenue from services of Rs. 2,192 Cr in Q4 FY25, growth of 6% YoY vs Rs. 2,076 Cr in
Q4 FY24
● EBITDA growth of more than 100% to Rs. 119 Cr (5.4% margin) in Q4 FY25 from Rs. 46
Cr (2.2% margin) in Q4 FY24
● Profit after tax1 of Rs. 73 Cr in Q4 FY25, an increase of Rs. 141 Cr YoY from a loss of
Rs. 69 Cr in Q4 FY24 making it the fourth consecutive profitable quarter
FY25 results snapshot:
● Revenue from services of Rs. 8,932 Cr in FY25, growth of 10% YoY from Rs. 8,142 Cr in
FY24
● EBITDA nearly tripled YoY to Rs. 376 (4.2% margin) Cr in FY25 from Rs. 127 (1.6%
margin) Cr in FY24
● Profit after tax1 of Rs. 162 Cr in FY25, an increase of Rs. 411 Cr YoY from a loss of Rs.
249 Cr in FY24, marking FY25 as the first full year of PAT profitability
Businesses snapshot:
Express Parcel
● Revenue grew 3% YoY to Rs. 1,256 Cr in Q4 FY25 from Rs. 1,217 Cr in Q4 FY24.
Revenue for the year grew 5% to Rs. 5,318 Cr in FY25 from Rs. 5,077 Cr in FY24
● Shipment volumes grew 1% YoY to 177 million in Q4 FY25 from 176 million in Q4 FY24.
Shipment volumes for the year grew 2% YoY to 752 million in FY25 from 740 million in
FY24, despite a decline in overall 3PL industry volumes and consumption headwinds,
reinforcing Delhivery’s strong market position
Part Truck Load
● Revenue grew 24% YoY to Rs. 517 Cr in Q4 FY25 from Rs. 417 Cr in Q4 FY24. Revenue
for the year grew 25% YoY to Rs. 1,889 Cr in FY25 from Rs. 1,517 Cr in FY24
● Volumes grew 19% YoY to 458K MT in Q4 FY25 from 384K MT in Q4 FY24. Volumes for
the year grew 19% YoY to 1,696K MT in FY25 from 1,429K MT in FY24

1 During Q4 FY25 and full year FY25, out of the total reduction in depreciation and amortisation expense, Rs. 69 Cr and Rs. 230 Cr
respectively was due to the change adopted in depreciation and amortisation method w.e.f. from April 1, 2024. Refer to the earnings
presentation for more details. The change in depreciation and amortisation method to SLM is in line with that followed by industry
peers
3:
● Service EBITDA margin expanded significantly to 10.8%, an increase of 866 bps YoY
from 2.2% in Q4 FY24. Service EBITDA margin for the full year was 5.4% vs -3.0% in
FY24, marking FY25 as the first full year of Service EBITDA profitability for PTL
Other businesses
● Supply Chain Services: Revenue for the quarter was Rs. 229 Cr in Q4 FY25 vs Rs. 234
Cr in Q4 FY24. Revenue for the full year was Rs. 907 Cr in FY25, a growth of 17% YoY
from Rs. 776 Cr in FY24
● Truckload: Revenue for the quarter was Rs. 151 Cr in Q4 FY25 vs. Rs. 174 Cr in Q4
FY24. Revenue for the full year was Rs. 626 Cr in FY25, a growth of 3% YoY from Rs.
609 Cr in FY24
● Cross Border Services: Revenue for the quarter was Rs. 34 Cr in Q4 FY25 vs. Rs. 31
Cr in Q4 FY24. Revenue for the full year was Rs. 179 Cr in FY25, a growth of 18% YoY
from Rs. 153 Cr in FY24
“We continue to deliver steady performance in our core transportation businesses. Our ongoing
measures to improve profitability are visible in Q4 numbers and we expect continued momentum
on this front as growth picks up in FY26.”, said Sahil Barua, MD & Chief Executive Officer.
Delhivery will host its earnings call to discuss Q4 FY25 results at 6:00 PM IST on Friday, May
16th, 2025. The registration link for the call has already been shared with the stock exchanges
and the link to the audio replay will be made available on the Investor Relations page of the
company’s website at https://www.delhivery.com/company/investor-relations following the
earnings call.
About Delhivery
Delhivery is India's largest fully-integrated logistics services provider. With its nationwide network
covering over 18,850 pin codes, the company provides a wide range of logistics services such as
express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology
services. Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 3.6 billion shipments since inception and today works
with over 44K+ customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other
enterprises & brands. For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
